summary:
Updated implementation plan with explicit Pixeldrain playback via /api/file/{id}:
1. Direct stream playback for Pixeldrain strictly uses the direct endpoint `https://pixeldrain.com/api/file/{id}` (or `https://pixeldrain.dev/api/file/{id}`).
2. FSL server streams directly from the FSL edge URL.
3. Subtitles and audio tracks are bound to the active server (extracted directly from the /api/file/ stream for Pixeldrain, and FSL stream for FSL server).
4. Download opens the extracted drive/file link in a new tab (/u/:id for Pixeldrain, FSL drive link for FSL server).
5. Referrals and standard request headers preserved without forced no-referrer.
6. Server selector in the player control bar is strictly icon-only with no text on the button.
7. Guarantees zero Vercel Fast Origin and Fast Data Transfer.
